title: SimCell script
description: Controller handbook page for the facilitator playing an outside party (the Simulation Cell): when to play the role, how to sound, the opening line, hard questions to ask, and what to concede only when players earn it. Never handed to players.

persona.description: Name the facilitator uses in character

examples: FBI Cleveland Field Office, Cyber Squad
Any player says they are calling the FBI or law enforcement about the AODB intrusion.
Phone (walk to the IT table and "answer")
Busy, skeptical, procedural. Interested only in evidence.
Agent Smith, Cyber. What have you got?

hardQuestions.description: Questions that make players work (3-6), in character

examples: Do you have a PCAP capture of the traffic?

concessions.description: What to give only when players earn it

condition.description: What the players must do or say
examples: They have preserved logs and can name the source IP

concession.description: What the role gives in return
examples: Agree to send an agent on site within two hours

boundaries.description: Things the role must not do or reveal

examples: Do not confirm terrorism or attribution

exitLine.description: How the role ends the call
examples: Call me back when you have evidence.

evaluatorNote.description: What the evaluator should look for in the players' response
examples: Excellence: IT preserved logs before calling and asks how to hand over images.

injectRefs.description: MSEL events where this role is likely to be called

scenarioTitle.description: Scenario name for the running head
